$comment: The `response` array below is the body of GET /api/programs, captured verbatim from the running server with `curl -s 'http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/programs?ids=cricos-061294J,cricos-111671D,cricos-103000K,cricos-092454G,cricos-083866G'` on 2026-10-29 (the five programs the six placeholders folded into; they keep their Chinese names, which the name-mapping tests need). It is here so a unit test can check the field names and the nullability the frontend adapter reads against the names the route actually serves, rather than against the adapter's own declarations. Recapture it, do not hand-edit it: an edit would turn the binding back into a transcript of this repository's own idea of the response. Three things in it are deliberate records of the contract and must not be normalised away: `name` is the Chinese program name while `nameEn` is the English one (so `ProgramView.name` has to come from `nameEn`), the five fields `city`, `degreeLevel`, `field`, `duration` and `englishRequirement` are nullable here (the captured programs happen to carry a value today, which is exactly why a fixture typed out by hand cannot notice the difference), and `source` carries only url, title and status, with no `id`, `excerpt` or `verifiedAt`.
